headline.title: PeopleSoft 0-day affecting hundreds of organizations steals gigabytes of data
headline.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability in Oracle's PeopleSoft software has been identified, affecting hundreds of organizations and enabling attackers to steal gigabytes of sensitive data. Organizations are urged to implement immediate security measures to mitigate the risk.

articles.title: Mistral is rumored to be raising €3B at €20B valuation
articles.summary: Mistral is reportedly seeking to raise €3 billion in a funding round that would value the company at approximately €20 billion, nearly doubling its previous Series C valuation of €11.7 billion. This potential investment highlights the company's significant growth and increasing market interest.

articles.title: Chinese cybercrime operation that used AI to scam ‘hundreds of thousands of victims’ sued by Google
articles.summary: Google has filed a lawsuit against a Chinese cybercrime group known as "Outsider Enterprise," which allegedly used AI to scam hundreds of thousands of victims by sending 2.5 million text messages in a two-week period. The lawsuit highlights the increasing use of AI in cybercrime activities.

articles.title: SpaceX IPO: Live updates on everything you need to know
articles.summary: TechCrunch provides comprehensive coverage of SpaceX's upcoming IPO, detailing its history, pre-IPO deals, and insights from its S-1 registration document. The article outlines potential winners and losers in the IPO process as the company prepares for this significant financial milestone.

articles.title: Elon Musk is the world’s first trillionaire
articles.summary: Elon Musk has become the world's first trillionaire following SpaceX's IPO, with his net worth surpassing $1 trillion, largely due to his 4.8 billion shares in SpaceX and his holdings in Tesla. The shares of SpaceX opened at $150 and have consistently remained above that price.

articles.title: SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI’s hot IPO summer
articles.summary: The IPO market is experiencing a resurgence with new players, notably the MANGOS group, which includes Meta (or Microsoft), Anthropic, Nvidia, Google, OpenAI, and SpaceX. Several of these companies are preparing to go public, presenting a significant test for investors and market valuations.

articles.title: China Didn’t Make Americans Hate Data Centers
articles.summary: The anti-data-center movement in the U.S. has been linked by some GOP lawmakers and tech investors to Chinese interference, but experts argue that the situation is more complex. The growing opposition to data centers involves various factors beyond foreign influence, highlighting a multifaceted debate.

articles.title: It’s hot IPO summer, and the MANGOS are ripe
articles.summary: The IPO market is experiencing a resurgence with a new group of companies, referred to as MANGOS—Meta (or Microsoft), Anthropic, Nvidia, Google, OpenAI, and SpaceX—leading the way. Several of these firms are set to go public simultaneously, presenting challenges for investors and raising questions about valuations.

articles.title: olmo-eval: An evaluation workbench for the model development loop
articles.summary: The article introduces "olmo-eval," a new evaluation workbench designed to streamline the model development loop for AI practitioners. It provides tools and frameworks to facilitate the assessment and improvement of machine learning models.

articles.title: SpaceX’s massive IPO: all the latest news
articles.summary: SpaceX's initial public offering (IPO) on Friday enables public investment in the company, which combines rocket technology, AI, and social media. The IPO has reportedly made Elon Musk the world's first trillionaire, surpassing the economies of several countries.

articles.title: Jeff Bezos’ AI startup aims to build an ‘artificial general engineer’
articles.summary: Jeff Bezos' new AI startup, Prometheus, aims to create an "artificial general engineer" that will develop AI-powered tools for designing physical products. The initiative was first reported by The New York Times last November and is now gaining more attention as it progresses.

articles.title: New OpenAI Academy courses for the next era of work
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched three new Academy courses designed to help individuals develop practical AI skills, establish repeatable workflows, and effectively implement AI agents in their daily tasks. These courses aim to prepare learners for the evolving demands of the modern workplace.
